messages:
inc-bot: INCIDENT CREATED INC-2026-349: smart-routing anomalies detected in prod; severity: high :rotating_light:

nora_oncall: seeing elevated 5xx on /generate-toolcall — looks correlated with smart-route decisions to q4_0 variants in eu-west
sanjay_mle: confirmed — telemetry: many requests with metadata `tool_call=true` were routed to q4_0 and returned unsupported-op errors
elaine_prodeng: that’s bad — we explicitly said quantized variants may not support tool calling. routing should exclude them for tool endpoints
ryan_sre: also seeing retry churn across regions. router falls back to us-east, then some requests come back to eu, causing oscillation
nora_oncall: customer impact: AlphaApp observed 503s for ~18m; CS flagged a paying customer. rough failed toolcall count ~7k in window
sanjay_mle: root cause hypothesis: compatibility matrix missing `tool_call` flag for q4_0 models, and routing policy checks cost/latency but not op support
elaine_prodeng: mitigation steps: 1) immediate policy patch to prefer fp16/fp32 for tool_call endpoints 2) disable cross-region retries temporarily 3) update compatibility matrix + rollout
ryan_sre: taking step 2 now: `rbctl routes update global --set "smart_route.cross_region_retries=0" --actor ryan_sre`
ops-bot: command executed by ryan_sre: smart_route.cross_region_retries set to 0
sanjay_mle: preparing routing patch. payload: 
```
{"match": {"tool_call": true}, "prefer": ["model:fp16","model:fp32"]}
```
nora_oncall: applying routing patch to prod
ops-bot: routing policy updated by nora_oncall (policy id: smart-001)
elaine_prodeng: adding explicit compatibility entries: `compatibility.model.q4_0.tool_call = false` and `compatibility.model.q8_0.tool_call = false`
sanjay_mle: pushing updated matrix to s3: `s3://redwood-config/compatibility/compat-2026-03-15.json` and triggering config-rollout
ryan_sre: enabling temporary circuit-breaker to reduce oscillation: `rbctl features enable smart-routing-cb --ttl 30m`
ops-bot: feature flag enabled: smart-routing-cb (expires in 30m)
nora_oncall: handoff in 10m to evening oncall @elaine_prodeng — summary: smart-route allowed quantized variants for toolcall endpoints causing unsupported-op failures and region fallback churn; mitigations applied: policy patch, cross-region retries disabled, cb enabled, matrix update in progress
elaine_prodeng: ack, will verify matrix rollout and confirm no regressions, schedule postmortem owners
sanjay_mle: postmortem owners assigned: sanjay_mle, ryan_sre, elaine_prodeng
inc-bot: INCIDENT INC-2026-349: status changed -> mitigated; severity downgraded to medium; follow-up ticket PM-2026-88 created
nora_oncall: closing pager, but keeping watch on synthetic probes and CS notifications
elaine_prodeng: root cause summary for PM: router decision logic prioritized cost/latency without consulting op-compatibility flags; missing unit tests for tool_call compatibility check
ryan_sre: logs snippet for reference:
```
2026-03-15T18:22:11Z router: decision id=abcd pref=q4_0 (cost=0.29) match={tool_call:true}
2026-03-15T18:22:11Z model-eu-01: reject: unsupported_op(tool_call)
2026-03-15T18:22:12Z router: fallback -> us-east-q4_0
```
sanjay_mle: extra note — we also observed q* variants truncating context in some cases which made tool signature detection fail; add context-length checks to compatibility matrix
ryan_sre: synthetic probes added: toolcall probe from eu + us-east every 5m, alert on >1% failures
nora_oncall: CS ticket CS-9071 updated with incident details and customer impact numbers; revenue exposure assessed as low but SLA blip recorded
inc-bot: INCIDENT INC-2026-349: closed
